structured_data.name: Privacy Policy
structured_data.description: Privacy Policy for IDFS Integrated Design and Fabrication Solutions

sections.title: Information We Collect
sections.content: We may collect information that you provide directly to us when you request a quote, submit project information, communicate with us, or visit our website. Types include: Personal Information (name, email, phone, company, address), Project Information (descriptions, specifications, drawings, files), Technical Information (IP address, browser type, device info, usage data).

sections.title: How We Use Your Information
sections.content: We use information solely for internal business purposes: responding to inquiries, processing proposals, communicating about projects, improving services, complying with legal obligations. We do not sell, rent, or share personal information with third parties for marketing purposes.

sections.title: Data Storage and Security
sections.content: We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect personal information. Information is stored on secure servers accessible only to authorized personnel.

sections.title: Information Sharing and Disclosure
sections.content: We do not share personal information except: with trusted service providers (under confidentiality agreements), when required by law, or in business transfers (merger, acquisition, sale).

sections.title: Cookies and Tracking Technologies
sections.content: Our website may use cookies and similar tracking technologies to enhance browsing experience and analyze traffic. You can control cookie preferences through browser settings.

sections.title: Your Rights and Choices
sections.content: You have the right to: access and review personal information, request corrections, request deletion (subject to legal obligations), opt-out of certain communications.

sections.title: Data Retention
sections.content: We retain personal information as long as necessary to fulfill purposes outlined in this policy, unless longer retention is required by law. Project-related information may be retained for business and legal purposes.

sections.title: Children's Privacy
sections.content: Our website and services are not directed to individuals under 18. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children.

sections.title: Changes to This Privacy Policy
sections.content: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of material changes by posting the new policy and updating the 'Last Updated' date.
